title: Those Who Came Down
subtitle: The Anunnaki, as the dreamers tell it
logline: The founding myth of the ancient-astronaut genre, told from inside for once: a tired crossing-world comes for gold, makes a worker out of clay and regret, and watches the worker out-create its makers.
market: committed-mythos mythic fiction (Sitchin / von Däniken register, played straight) — the shadow-twin of The Princely Offspring and The Walls of Uruk

kin.debunk_twin: books/anunnaki-mesopotamia (The Princely Offspring — kills this reading in the clay)
